title: FlowSteer: Towards Agents Designing Agentic Workflows via Reinforced Progressive Canvas Editing
abstract: arXiv:2602.01664v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In recent years, agentic workflows have been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing workflow construction still faces key challenges, including human-dependent workflow construction, the lack of graph-level execution feedback, and the inability to repair errors in-loop during long-horizon construction. To address these challenges, we propose FlowSteer, a new paradigm of Agent Designing Agentic Workflows - a single agent itself end-to-end designs the workflow that a downstream executor runs. To support this paradigm, we introduce the Workflow Canvas, a novel executable graph-state environment that returns syntax-checked execution feedback for every atomic edit. Built on the canvas, we further propose Reinforced Progressive Canvas Editing, in which a lightweight policy agent issues one atomic edit per turn conditioned on real canvas feedback, and is trained end-to-end via reinforcement learning. translated_title: FlowSteer：迈向由智能体通过强化渐进式画布编辑来设计智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 近年来，智能体工作流已被广泛应用于解决复杂的人类任务。然而，现有的工作流构建仍面临若干关键挑战，包括依赖人工的工作流构建方式、缺乏图级别的执行反馈，以及无法在长时程构建过程中进行在线错误修复。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 FlowSteer——一种“智能体设计智能体工作流”的新范式，即由单个智能体自身端到端地设计出供下游执行器运行的工作流。为支持这一范式，我们引入了工作流画布，这是一种新颖的可执行图状态环境，能够为每一次原子编辑返回经过语法检查的执行反馈。基于该画布，我们进一步提出了强化渐进式画布编辑，其中一个轻量级策略智能体在每一轮基于真实的画布反馈发出一次原子编辑，并通过强化学习进行端到端训练。此外，FlowSteer……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: FlowSteer 提出了一种新范式，由单个轻量级智能体在可执行的工作流画布环境中，通过强化学习训练的渐进式原子画布编辑，端到端地自主设计供下游执行器运行的智能体工作流，并获得语法检查级别的实时执行反馈。
en_tdlr: FlowSteer introduces a new paradigm in which a single lightweight agent, trained via reinforcement learning, end-to-end designs agentic workflows through progressive atomic edits on an executable Workflow Canvas environment that provides syntax-checked execution feedback at each step.
